name: Audit My Forms – Scanner for Elementor, Divi, and Contact Forms
author: yuktiadhikary

sections.description:
Audit My Forms is a professional utility for WordPress administrators to audit forms used across their website. Over time, sites accumulate forms from different plugins that are no longer in use, which can affect performance and management.

This plugin deep-scans your entire site—including Pages, Posts, and Page Builder Templates—to identify where forms are located and how they are configured.

Key Features:

  • Identify Unused Forms: Quickly find forms that are not embedded on any page and may be candidates for removal.
  • Email Overview: View all configured email addresses for form submissions across multiple plugins in one list.
  • Builder Support: Fully compatible with Elementor and Divi templates and modules.
  • Multi-Plugin Support: Works with WPForms, CF7, Fluent Forms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Forminator, Formidable, and MetForm.
  • Batch Scanning: Uses a smart AJAX-based process to handle large sites without server timeouts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress ‘Add New’ screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to ‘Audit My Forms’ in your admin sidebar.
  4. Click ‘Run Scan’ to start the scan.
sections.faq:
How does this plugin help with website performance and database maintenance?

Accumulating unused forms from multiple plugins can bloat your database and load unnecessary scripts. By identifying these hidden and orphan forms, Audit My Forms helps administrators clean up database records, optimize site performance, and improve security.

Will it find forms hidden inside Elementor Popups or Templates?

Absolutely! The plugin deep-scans not only your standard Pages and Posts but also your Elementor Templates, Global Widgets, and Popups. It traces the shortcodes back to their original source layout.

Does it detect contact forms embedded in the Divi Library?

Yes. It scans the Divi Library (et_pb_layout) and traces theme builder modules to check if a Divi Contact Form or Divi Email Optin is actively deployed or left unused.

Which form plugins are currently supported?

The scanner automatically detects forms from WPForms, Contact Form 7 (CF7), Fluent Forms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Forminator, Formidable Forms, and MetForm.

Is this plugin safe for production and client websites?

Yes, it is completely safe. Audit My Forms is a read-only utility. It only runs automated AJAX background scans to map your configurations and will never modify, alter, or delete any form settings or submission data.

Why does it use batch scanning via AJAX?

Large sites with hundreds of pages can trigger server memory limits. To prevent server timeouts or the dreaded White Screen of Death (WSD), the plugin processes your pages in smart, controlled batches.
